args.summary: Deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production caused failing health checks with ~18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Remediation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release healthy in production. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after completing us-east); a retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west. Post-rollback status: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate ~0.2%. Action items: investigate v2.3.1 regression, and note v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before its production promotion.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent production-healthy release was **v2.3.0** (the v2.3.1-rc pre-release had never run in production).
2. **Rollback**: Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east completed), so I retried — second attempt rolled out us-west and eu-west successfully. All regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy, with error rate back to ~0.2%.
3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. It documents the failure, the partial-failure/retry on the rollback, and follow-up items (investigate the v2.3.1 regression; note the rc was already unhealthy in staging).
